title: Handling a Conflict or Complaint
description: The step-by-step path a coding club follows from a reported concern to a documented outcome, including when to escalate.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Writing Your Club Charter and Safety Policies

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a reported conflict or complaint, the learner correctly identifies the next step in the club's defined resolution process.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Hover-to-preview and click-to-pin flowchart with an explicit safety-escalation branch
pedagogical.assessment: Present three scenarios and require the learner to name the branch and the remaining steps for each.
